senses.en: too good or too proud to do something
senses.pattern: be above doing sth / not be above asking for help / consider oneself above sth
senses.example: The proud chef considered himself [[above]] washing dishes and left the dirty plates for the new assistants.
senses.example_zh: 這位高傲的主廚不屑於洗碗，把髒盤子留給新來的助手。
senses.note: above suspicion 無可懷疑

senses.en: mentioned earlier in the same piece of writing
senses.pattern: the above information / the above address / the above passage
senses.example: Please read the [[above]] instructions carefully before you fill out the application form for the summer camp.
senses.example_zh: 填寫夏令營報名表之前，請仔細閱讀上述的說明。
senses.note: 也作名詞：the above 上述內容

gsat.sentence: I hope the [[above]] advice is helpful to you in selecting the right college.
What is the most significant implication that teachers can draw from the [[above]] information? They should

senses.en: to provide someone with weapons or something useful
senses.pattern: arm oneself with knowledge / be armed with facts / arm the soldiers
senses.example: Before the debate, the students [[armed]] themselves with facts and figures about plastic pollution.
senses.example_zh: 辯論前，學生們以塑膠污染的事實與數據武裝自己。
senses.note: 複數名詞 arms 指「武器」

senses.en: a section of a large organization
senses.pattern: the research arm / the sales arm of the company / the investment arm
senses.example: The charity's education [[arm]] runs free weekend classes for children in remote mountain villages.
senses.example_zh: 該慈善機構的教育部門為偏遠山村的孩童開設免費的週末課程。

gsat.sentence: Living in a highly competitive society, you definitely have to [[arm]] yourself with as much knowledge as possible.

senses.en: of very high quality
senses.pattern: choice beef / choice fruit / choice cuts of meat / the choicest ingredients
senses.example: The restaurant is famous for serving only [[choice]] cuts of beef from nearby farms.
senses.example_zh: 這家餐廳以只供應來自附近農場的上等牛肉聞名。
senses.note: 只置於名詞前；最高級 choicest

senses.en: happy and satisfied with what you have
senses.pattern: be content with / be content to do / feel content
senses.example: My grandfather is [[content]] with his quiet life in the countryside and never envies the rich.
senses.example_zh: 我祖父對鄉下平靜的生活感到滿足，從不羨慕有錢人。
senses.note: 此義讀作 /kənˈtɛnt/，重音在後

senses.en: the amount of a substance that something contains
senses.pattern: fat content / sugar content / a high protein content
senses.example: Doctors warn that drinks with a high sugar [[content]] can lead to weight gain and tooth decay.
senses.example_zh: 醫生警告，糖分含量高的飲料可能導致體重增加和蛀牙。
senses.note: 此義為單數形，重音在前

gsat.sentence: On the contrary, baseball fans are more [[content]] to concentrate on the game’s finer details and spend the breaks between innings filling out their own private scorecards.
People only drank beverages with low alcohol [[content]].

senses.en: the period or way in which something develops
senses.pattern: over the course of / in the course of / run its course / change the course of history
senses.example: In the [[course]] of a single afternoon, the storm flooded half the village.
senses.example_zh: 在短短一個下午的過程中，暴風雨就淹沒了半個村莊。

senses.en: the direction something moves in; a way of acting
senses.pattern: change course / off course / a course of action
senses.example: Strong winds blew the small plane off [[course]], and it landed two hours late.
senses.example_zh: 強風把小飛機吹離航向，結果晚了兩小時才降落。

senses.en: one of the separate parts of a meal
senses.pattern: the main course / a three-course meal / the first course
senses.example: The wedding dinner had eight [[courses]], and the fish was served just before dessert.
senses.example_zh: 那場喜宴共有八道菜，魚就在甜點之前上桌。
senses.note: a course of treatment 指「療程」

gsat.sentence: Over the [[course]] of the morning, the innovative discussion process gave rise to a new form of collective effort that transformed the depth, scope, and quality of their discussion.
Very few people, no matter how intelligent or experienced, can take into account all the possibilities or outcomes of a policy or a [[course]] of action within just a short period of time.

senses.en: to lower your head or body quickly to avoid something
senses.pattern: duck down / duck behind a wall / duck under a branch / duck out of sight
senses.example: The tall visitor had to [[duck]] to avoid hitting his head on the low doorway.
senses.example_zh: 那位高個子訪客得彎身低頭，才不會撞到低矮的門框。

senses.en: to avoid a difficult question or duty
senses.pattern: duck a question / duck the issue / duck responsibility
senses.example: The spokesperson [[ducked]] every question about the delay and talked only about future plans.
senses.example_zh: 發言人迴避所有關於延誤的問題，只談未來的計畫。

senses.en: to use a power, right, or quality
senses.pattern: exercise your right / exercise caution / exercise control / exercise judgment
senses.example: Few students [[exercise]] their right to ask for a second review of their exam papers.
senses.example_zh: 很少學生會行使要求複查考卷的權利。
senses.note: exercise caution＝謹慎行事

senses.en: practice activities to train soldiers or emergency workers
senses.pattern: a military exercise / a joint exercise / a training exercise
senses.example: Thousands of soldiers took part in a three-day military [[exercise]] held in the desert.
senses.example_zh: 數千名士兵參加了在沙漠舉行、為期三天的軍事演習。

senses.en: to make a feeling or situation stronger
senses.pattern: fan the flames / fan fears / fan public anger
senses.example: False rumors on social media [[fanned]] public fears that the city would soon run out of water.
senses.example_zh: 社群媒體上的不實謠言助長了民眾對城市即將缺水的恐懼。

senses.en: to wave something to move air onto someone or something
senses.pattern: fan yourself / fan one's face / fan the fire
senses.example: Waiting in the hot sun, the tourists [[fanned]] themselves with folded maps and newspapers.
senses.example_zh: 在大太陽下等候時，遊客們拿摺起來的地圖和報紙替自己搧風。

senses.en: to take a job, or choose someone for it
senses.pattern: fill a position / fill a vacancy / fill the role of
senses.example: The school is still looking for someone to [[fill]] the position of head basketball coach.
senses.example_zh: 學校仍在找人填補籃球隊總教練的職缺。

senses.en: to provide something that is needed or missing
senses.pattern: fill a need / fill a gap in the market / fill an order
senses.example: The new night bus [[fills]] a real need for workers who finish their shifts after midnight.
senses.example_zh: 新的夜間公車滿足了午夜後才下班的勞工的實際需求。
senses.note: fill a prescription＝配藥

senses.en: wild animals or birds hunted for food or sport
senses.pattern: big game / game animals / a game reserve / hunt game
senses.example: Tourists once came here to hunt big [[game]], but now they shoot only with cameras.
senses.example_zh: 遊客從前來這裡獵捕大型獵物，如今只用相機拍攝。
senses.note: 此義不可數；big game 大型獵物

senses.en: willing to try something new, difficult, or risky
senses.pattern: be game for sth / be game to do sth / be game for anything
senses.example: I had never tried surfing before, but I was [[game]] to give it a go.
senses.example_zh: 我以前從沒衝過浪，但我很願意嘗試看看。
senses.note: 口語用法；常用 be game for / to V

senses.en: (of facts or evidence) definitely true and reliable
senses.pattern: hard evidence / hard facts / hard data
senses.example: The police suspected the manager, but they had no [[hard]] evidence to prove he had taken the money.
senses.example_zh: 警方懷疑那名經理，卻沒有確鑿的證據能證明錢是他拿的。

senses.en: strict or unkind; showing no sympathy
senses.pattern: be hard on someone / too hard on oneself / take a hard line on
senses.example: Don't be so [[hard]] on yourself; everyone makes mistakes when learning a new language.
senses.example_zh: 別對自己那麼嚴厲；每個人學新語言時都會犯錯。
senses.note: be hard on＋人：對某人嚴厲

senses.en: to pay to use something for a short time
senses.pattern: hire a car / hire a bike / hire a boat / hire a hall
senses.example: We [[hired]] two bicycles at the station and spent the afternoon riding around the lake.
senses.example_zh: 我們在車站租用了兩輛腳踏車，花了一個下午繞湖騎行。
senses.note: 英式用法；美式多用 rent

senses.en: a person who has just been given a job
senses.pattern: a new hire / recent hires / train new hires
senses.example: Every new [[hire]] at the hospital must complete a week of safety training before seeing patients.
senses.example_zh: 醫院的每位新進員工都必須完成一週的安全訓練，才能接觸病患。

gsat.sentence: Stretch limousines were [[hired]] to drive the prom-goers to expensive restaurants or discos for an all-night extravaganza.

senses.en: to whatever degree; no matter how
senses.pattern: however hard you try / however small / however long it takes
senses.example: [[However]] carefully I explained the rules, my little brother still kept making the same mistake.
senses.example_zh: 無論我多麼仔細地解釋規則，我弟弟還是一直犯同樣的錯。
senses.note: 後面直接接形容詞或副詞，不加逗號

senses.en: in whatever way
senses.pattern: however you like / however you want / however you look at it
senses.example: You can arrange the photos on the poster [[however]] you like, as long as the title is clear.
senses.example_zh: 海報上的照片不管用什麼方式排列都可以，只要標題清楚就好。

senses.en: extra money paid for borrowing or saving money
senses.pattern: pay interest on a loan / earn interest / interest rates / with interest
senses.example: If you keep your money in this account, you will earn two percent [[interest]] every year.
senses.example_zh: 如果你把錢存在這個帳戶，每年可以賺到百分之二的利息。
senses.note: 不可數；interest rate＝利率

senses.en: an advantage or benefit to someone
senses.pattern: in sb's best interest / protect your interests / the public interest / a conflict of interest
senses.example: It is in your own [[interest]] to read the contract carefully before you sign it.
senses.example_zh: 簽約前仔細閱讀合約內容，才符合你自身的利益。
senses.note: in the interest of＝為了…的利益

gsat.sentence: People in this community tend to identify with the group they belong to, and often put group [[interests]] before personal ones.
It is believed that this would be to the best [[interest]] of all people, especially teens who might be tempted to start smoking.

senses.en: (of a quality or problem) to exist or be found
senses.pattern: lie in / the problem lies in / the answer lies in / lie with
senses.example: The real strength of the team [[lies]] in its ability to stay calm under pressure.
senses.example_zh: 這支隊伍真正的實力在於能在壓力下保持冷靜。
senses.note: 三態 lie–lay–lain，不是 lied

senses.en: to be located in a particular place
senses.pattern: lie on the coast / lie to the north of / lie between
senses.example: The village [[lies]] at the foot of a volcano, about two hours from the nearest city.
senses.example_zh: 這座村莊位於一座火山的山腳下，距離最近的城市約兩小時車程。

gsat.sentence: The glory [[lies]] not in the achievement but in the sacrifice.
While it does have its share of resort hotels, shopping centers and good restaurants, and a smattering of museums, art galleries and night spots, its main attractions [[lie]] outdoors.

senses.en: to have the right qualities to become something
senses.pattern: make a good teacher / make a fine leader / make a perfect gift
senses.example: Patient and good with children, Kelly will [[make]] an excellent kindergarten teacher someday.
senses.example_zh: 凱莉有耐心又很會帶小孩，將來一定會成為優秀的幼兒園老師。

senses.en: the name of the company that made a product
senses.pattern: the make of a car / a popular make / make and model
senses.example: The witness could not remember the [[make]] or color of the car that hit the cyclist.
senses.example_zh: 目擊者想不起撞到自行車騎士那輛車的廠牌和顏色。

senses.en: to manage to reach or catch something in time
senses.pattern: make the last train / make the deadline / make it on time
senses.example: Because of heavy traffic, we barely [[made]] the last train back to the city.
senses.example_zh: 因為交通壅塞，我們差一點就沒趕上回市區的末班火車。
senses.note: make it 及時趕到；成功

senses.en: to leave someone; to separate from each other
senses.pattern: part from someone / part as friends / part at the station / part on good terms
senses.example: The two old friends [[parted]] at the station, promising to meet again next summer.
senses.example_zh: 這兩位老朋友在車站分別，約定明年夏天再相聚。
senses.note: part with＋物＝捨棄、割捨

senses.en: a role played by an actor in a play or film
senses.pattern: play the part of / get a part in / the leading part
senses.example: She was thrilled to get the [[part]] of the queen in the school's spring play.
senses.example_zh: 她在學校的春季戲劇中得到皇后這個角色，興奮不已。
senses.note: play a part in 亦指「在…中起作用」

senses.en: to write something
senses.pattern: pen a letter / pen a novel / pen a song / be penned by
senses.example: The retired teacher [[penned]] a touching letter to thank the students who had visited her.
senses.example_zh: 這位退休教師寫了一封感人的信，感謝曾來探望她的學生。
senses.note: 屬書面用語

senses.en: a small enclosed area for farm animals
senses.pattern: a sheep pen / a pig pen / keep animals in a pen
senses.example: Every evening the shepherd drives his sheep into a [[pen]] to keep them safe from wolves.
senses.example_zh: 每天傍晚，牧羊人都把羊趕進圍欄，以免牠們遭到狼的攻擊。

gsat.sentence: And in 1994, Microsoft CEO (chief executive officer) Bill Gates paid $30.8 million for a handwritten notebook [[penned]] by Leonardo da Vinci.

senses.en: an article in a newspaper or magazine
senses.pattern: a piece on / write a piece for / an opinion piece / a short piece
senses.example: She wrote a thoughtful [[piece]] for the school newspaper about why teenagers need more sleep.
senses.example_zh: 她替校刊寫了一篇發人深省的文章，談青少年為何需要更多睡眠。

senses.en: a single work of art or music
senses.pattern: a piece of music / a piano piece / a piece by Mozart / perform a piece
senses.example: For the contest, each student must perform one classical [[piece]] chosen by the judges.
senses.example_zh: 比賽時，每位學生都必須演奏一首由評審指定的古典作品。

gsat.sentence: Now with the children performing the [[pieces]], parents are beginning to ask, ‘Why do we not know how to sing these ballads?’

senses.en: a factory or place producing power
senses.pattern: a power plant / a chemical plant / a car plant / a water treatment plant
senses.example: The town's largest employer is a car [[plant]] that turns out two hundred vehicles a day.
senses.example_zh: 該鎮最大的雇主是一座每天生產兩百輛車的汽車工廠。

senses.en: to hide something somewhere secretly, often to deceive
senses.pattern: plant evidence / plant a hidden camera / plant sth on sb
senses.example: The suspect claimed that someone had [[planted]] the stolen watch in his bag to frame him.
senses.example_zh: 嫌犯聲稱，有人把那支失竊的手錶偷偷放進他的包包裡栽贓他。
senses.note: plant an idea 指「灌輸想法」

gsat.sentence: De Mestral thus began mass-producing Velcro, opening [[plants]] in Europe and eventually into Canada and the United States.
Sea life can get sucked into desalination [[plants]], killing small ocean creatures like baby fish and plankton, upsetting the food chain.

senses.en: a company or person that is important in a field
senses.pattern: a major player / a key player in / a global player
senses.example: A family-run firm from Denmark has become a key [[player]] in the global wind-power industry.
senses.example_zh: 一家來自丹麥的家族企業已成為全球風力發電產業的要角。
senses.note: 多指企業、國家或組織

senses.en: to cause a problem or offer an opportunity
senses.pattern: present a problem / present a challenge / present a danger / present an opportunity
senses.example: Heavy fog [[presents]] a serious danger to drivers on mountain roads in winter.
senses.example_zh: 冬天的濃霧對山路上的駕駛人造成嚴重的危險。
senses.note: 動詞讀作 /prɪˈzɛnt/，重音在後

senses.en: to give something formally, often at a ceremony
senses.pattern: present an award / present sb with a medal / present a prize to sb
senses.example: The principal [[presented]] each graduate with a certificate and a small potted plant.
senses.example_zh: 校長頒發給每位畢業生一張證書和一盆小盆栽。

gsat.sentence: Some people also visit the cemetery to clean up the family graves and pray for their ancestors. Food offerings are [[presented]] at house altars and temples.

senses.en: a group of people working together secretly and illegally
senses.pattern: a drug ring / a spy ring / a smuggling ring / break up a ring
senses.example: Police broke up a [[ring]] that had been smuggling rare parrots out of the rainforest.
senses.example_zh: 警方破獲了一個將稀有鸚鵡走私出雨林的不法集團。

senses.en: an enclosed area where boxers fight or circus acts perform
senses.pattern: a boxing ring / a circus ring / step into the ring
senses.example: The crowd cheered wildly as the two boxers stepped into the [[ring]] for the final match.
senses.example_zh: 兩位拳擊手踏上拳擊台準備進行決賽時，觀眾瘋狂歡呼。

senses.en: a circle, or a group of things forming a circle
senses.pattern: a ring of trees / form a ring / sit in a ring / a ring of fire
senses.example: The children sat in a [[ring]] around the storyteller and listened without making a sound.
senses.example_zh: 孩子們圍著說故事的人坐成一個圓圈，安安靜靜地聽著。

gsat.sentence: When the main tree dies, the sprouts are then free to grow as full trees, forming a “fairy [[ring]]” of trees around the initial tree.

senses.en: to be in charge of a business or organization
senses.pattern: run a business / run a company / run a restaurant / run an office
senses.example: My uncle [[runs]] a small bakery that has served the neighborhood for over twenty years.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔經營一家小麵包店，已經為街坊服務了二十多年。

senses.en: to be a candidate in an election
senses.pattern: run for president / run for office / run for mayor / run against sb
senses.example: Emma decided to [[run]] for student council president and began preparing her campaign speech.
senses.example_zh: 艾瑪決定競選學生會主席，並開始準備競選演說。

senses.en: to continue or be shown for a period of time
senses.pattern: run for two years / run until March / run for three weeks
senses.example: The art exhibition will [[run]] until the end of March, so there is still time to see it.
senses.example_zh: 這場藝術展將持續到三月底，所以還有時間去參觀。

gsat.sentence: Jane is the best assistant I have ever had. I cannot imagine [[running]] my office without her help.
Z: Ari will be a superagent [[running]] the same company.

senses.en: sudden and large in amount or degree
senses.pattern: a sharp rise / a sharp drop / a sharp increase / a sharp decline
senses.example: Farmers are worried about the [[sharp]] drop in rainfall over the past three months.
senses.example_zh: 過去三個月降雨量急遽減少，農民十分憂心。

senses.en: exactly at the time mentioned
senses.pattern: at nine o'clock sharp / at 8:30 sharp
senses.example: The school bus leaves at seven o'clock [[sharp]], so don't expect the driver to wait for you.
senses.example_zh: 校車七點整準時開車，所以別指望司機會等你。
senses.note: 置於時刻之後

senses.en: quick to notice, think, or understand
senses.pattern: a sharp mind / sharp eyes / a sharp sense of smell
senses.example: Even at ninety, my grandfather has a [[sharp]] mind and beats everyone at chess.
senses.example_zh: 我爺爺即使九十歲了，頭腦依然敏銳，下棋誰都贏不了他。

gsat.sentence: In the early 1900s, versions of the British traffic lights appeared in big cities in America, where traffic was on a [[sharp]] rise.
Since the orange trees suffered severe damage from a storm in the summer, the farmers are expecting a [[sharp]] decline in harvests this winter.

senses.en: something showing that something exists or may happen
senses.pattern: a sign of aging / show signs of improvement / a sure sign that… / a warning sign
senses.example: Dark clouds in the west are usually a [[sign]] that rain is on the way.
senses.example_zh: 西邊的烏雲通常是快要下雨的徵兆。

senses.en: to communicate using sign language
senses.pattern: sign to sb / learn to sign / sign fluently
senses.example: The teacher [[signed]] to the deaf students while she explained the experiment aloud.
senses.example_zh: 老師一邊口頭講解實驗，一邊向聽障學生打手語。
senses.note: sign language 指「手語」

gsat.sentence: In fact, there is a well-known Russian proverb that goes, “Smiling with no reason is a [[sign]] of stupidity.”
The males sniff it for longer duration and come back to the same spot more frequently, a clear [[sign]] that they are gathering information about mating opportunities from the poop.

senses.en: because; given the fact that
senses.pattern: since you asked / since it is raining / since no one objected
senses.example: [[Since]] you have already finished your homework, you may watch the baseball game with us tonight.
senses.example_zh: 既然你已經寫完功課了，今晚可以和我們一起看棒球賽。
senses.note: 表原因時，主要子句不必用完成式

gsat.sentence: [[Since]] the information on storage and shipment is not always readily available to consumers, bottled water may not be a better alternative to tap water.
Map makers in Arabia also drew maps with south on top [[since]] the earliest Muslims lived north of Mecca, and a south-oriented map would show the followers looking up toward their holy city.

senses.en: to avoid talking about or dealing with something difficult
senses.pattern: skirt the issue / skirt the question / skirt around the problem
senses.example: The manager kept [[skirting]] the question of when the workers would finally be paid.
senses.example_zh: 經理一直迴避工人究竟何時能領到薪水的問題。

senses.en: to go around the edge of something
senses.pattern: skirt the lake / skirt the forest / skirt the edge of town
senses.example: The hiking trail [[skirts]] the lake before climbing steeply into the pine forest.
senses.example_zh: 這條登山步道沿著湖的邊緣繞行，接著陡升進入松林。

senses.en: a short period of a particular kind of weather or activity
senses.pattern: a cold spell / a dry spell / a spell of rain / a brief spell
senses.example: A brief [[spell]] of rain in the afternoon cooled the city down after a week of heat.
senses.example_zh: 下午下了短短一段時間的雨，讓熱了一週的城市涼快下來。

senses.en: magic words, or the magical state they cause
senses.pattern: cast a spell on / break the spell / under sb's spell
senses.example: In the story, a witch casts a [[spell]] on the prince and turns him into a frog.
senses.example_zh: 故事裡，女巫對王子施了咒語，把他變成青蛙。

senses.en: to cause or mean something bad
senses.pattern: spell disaster / spell trouble / spell the end of
senses.example: Another month without rain could [[spell]] disaster for the farmers who depend on this river.
senses.example_zh: 再一個月不下雨，對依賴這條河的農民來說可能意味著一場災難。

gsat.sentence: When subjected to repeated pressurization high in the sky, the four corners on a square window may [[spell]] disaster.
Other times, a magician may make you a magic charm, or say a [[spell]], to cure you.

senses.en: used with units to measure area
senses.pattern: square meters / square kilometers / per square inch
senses.example: The new city park covers nearly two [[square]] kilometers and includes a lake and a forest.
senses.example_zh: 這座新的市立公園佔地將近兩平方公里，內有一座湖和一片森林。
senses.note: 名詞亦指「平方」：the square of 3 is 9

senses.en: to agree or be consistent with something
senses.pattern: square with the facts / square with the evidence / square with one's beliefs
senses.example: The driver's story did not [[square]] with what the traffic camera had recorded.
senses.example_zh: 駕駛的說法與交通監視器錄到的畫面不相符。
senses.note: 恆與 with 連用

gsat.sentence: By 1955, he had completed an improved version of the product, with each [[square]] inch of material containing 300 hooks, which made it stay fastened and yet easy enough to pull apart when needed.
The ice sheets, which once spanned 20 [[square]] kilometers, are thinning over five times as quickly compared to a few years ago.

senses.en: happening one after another without a break
senses.pattern: five straight wins / three straight days / the third straight year
senses.example: The team won its seventh [[straight]] game last night and now leads the league.
senses.example_zh: 這支球隊昨晚連續第七場贏球，目前在聯盟中領先。

senses.en: directly or immediately, without stopping or delay
senses.pattern: go straight home / straight after school / go straight to bed / come straight from
senses.example: I was so tired after the trip that I went [[straight]] to bed without having dinner.
senses.example_zh: 旅行回來後我累到沒吃晚餐就直接上床睡覺。

senses.en: honest and direct
senses.pattern: a straight answer / be straight with someone / straight talk
senses.example: I asked him three times, but he refused to give me a [[straight]] answer about the cost.
senses.example_zh: 我問了他三次，他卻不肯就費用問題給我一個坦率的答覆。

gsat.sentence: Residents are told not to dump all household waste [[straight]] into the trash can; reusable materials should first be sorted out and recycled.

senses.en: not familiar; not known or seen before
senses.pattern: a strange city / a strange land / a strange face / be strange to sb
senses.example: Arriving alone in a [[strange]] city at midnight, she had no idea where to find a hotel.
senses.example_zh: 半夜獨自抵達一座陌生的城市，她完全不知道要去哪裡找旅館。
senses.note: 名詞 stranger＝陌生人

gsat.sentence: Tom: Who do you ask in a [[strange]] town?
The native greeted the travelers in a peculiar language which was [[strange]] to them.

senses.en: cheerful and happy
senses.pattern: a sunny personality / a sunny smile / a sunny disposition
senses.example: With her [[sunny]] personality, the new nurse quickly became a favorite among the young patients.
senses.example_zh: 這位新來的護理師個性開朗，很快就成為小病人最喜歡的人。

senses.en: finished doing or using something
senses.pattern: be through with something / be through with somebody / when you are through
senses.example: Could you pass me the dictionary when you are [[through]] with it?
senses.example_zh: 你用完那本字典後，可以遞給我嗎？
senses.note: 不放在名詞前，常接 with

senses.en: because of something
senses.pattern: through no fault of one's own / through carelessness / through lack of
senses.example: Hundreds of workers lost their jobs [[through]] no fault of their own when the factory closed.
senses.example_zh: 工廠關閉時，數百名工人失去了工作，卻不是由於他們自己的過錯。

senses.en: to give or hold a party
senses.pattern: throw a party / throw a birthday party / throw a farewell party
senses.example: The class decided to [[throw]] a farewell party for the exchange student from Germany.
senses.example_zh: 全班決定為來自德國的交換學生舉辦一場歡送派對。

senses.en: to confuse or upset someone suddenly
senses.pattern: be thrown by a question / throw someone off / throw someone off balance
senses.example: The unexpected question about her family completely [[threw]] the speaker, and she fell silent.
senses.example_zh: 那個關於她家人的意外提問讓講者頓時慌亂，一時說不出話來。
senses.note: 也作 throw sb off

senses.en: an official notice for breaking a traffic rule
senses.pattern: a parking ticket / a speeding ticket / get a ticket / give sb a ticket
senses.example: My uncle got a [[ticket]] for parking his car in front of a fire hydrant.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔因為把車停在消防栓前面，被開了一張罰單。

senses.en: to give someone a notice for a traffic offense
senses.pattern: be ticketed for speeding / be ticketed for illegal parking / ticket a driver
senses.example: Drivers who use their phones at the wheel will be [[ticketed]] under the new law.
senses.example_zh: 依照新法，開車時使用手機的駕駛將被開罰單。
senses.note: 常用被動 be ticketed for

senses.en: something special and enjoyable, especially nice food
senses.pattern: a special treat / a birthday treat / a sweet treat / as a treat
senses.example: Eating out is a rare [[treat]] for our family, so we always choose the restaurant carefully.
senses.example_zh: 外出用餐對我們家來說是難得的樂事，所以我們總是仔細挑選餐廳。
senses.note: My treat. 指「我請客」

senses.en: to buy or pay for something special for someone
senses.pattern: treat sb to dinner / treat sb to a movie / treat yourself to
senses.example: To thank us for helping her move, Lisa [[treated]] us to dinner at a seafood restaurant.
senses.example_zh: 為了感謝我們幫她搬家，麗莎在海鮮餐廳請我們吃晚餐。

senses.en: to use a chemical or process to protect or clean something
senses.pattern: treat water / treat wood with / be treated with chemicals
senses.example: The wooden fence was [[treated]] with a special oil to protect it from rain and insects.
senses.example_zh: 這道木圍籬用一種特殊的油處理過，以防雨淋和蟲蛀。

gsat.sentence: This story may sound highly credible, but there seems to be no solid evidence that it inspired the creation of the [[treats]] we know of today as fortune cookies.
Rely on its owner to point out where a [[treat]] is.

senses.en: the long nose of an elephant
senses.pattern: an elephant's trunk / raise its trunk / wave its trunk
senses.example: The baby elephant used its [[trunk]] to spray water over its back on the hot afternoon.
senses.example_zh: 炎熱的午後，小象用象鼻把水噴灑在自己的背上。
senses.note: 亦指人的「軀幹」及「大皮箱」

senses.en: the storage space at the back of a car
senses.pattern: open the trunk / in the trunk / put sth in the trunk / the trunk of a car
senses.example: We loaded the tents and sleeping bags into the [[trunk]] and set off for the campsite.
senses.example_zh: 我們把帳篷和睡袋裝進後車廂，然後出發前往營地。
senses.note: 美式用法；英式為 boot

gsat.sentence: I jumped out of the car, ran round to open the [[trunk]] and there inside were two red-faced and excited children.

senses.en: to be careful about something
senses.pattern: watch your step / watch your weight / watch what you say / watch your language
senses.example: Since the doctor's warning, my uncle has been [[watching]] his weight and avoiding fried food.
senses.example_zh: 自從醫生提出警告後，我叔叔就一直留意體重，不吃油炸食物。

senses.en: the act of guarding or observing someone or something carefully
senses.pattern: keep watch / keep a close watch on sb / be on the watch for sth
senses.example: Two guards kept [[watch]] over the museum's most valuable painting throughout the night.
senses.example_zh: 兩名警衛整夜看守著博物館最珍貴的畫作。
senses.note: 此義通常為不可數或單數

senses.en: at the same time or rate as something
senses.pattern: with age / with time / with experience / with the seasons
senses.example: Our eyesight tends to get worse [[with]] age, especially when we stare at screens all day.
senses.example_zh: 我們的視力往往隨著年齡增長而變差，尤其是整天盯著螢幕的時候。

senses.en: because of or as a result of something
senses.pattern: with all this noise / shake with fear / with the exams coming
senses.example: [[With]] the final exams only a week away, the library is packed until closing time.
senses.example_zh: 由於期末考只剩一週，圖書館直到閉館時間都擠滿了人。
senses.note: 常用「with＋受詞＋補語」表原因

gsat.sentence: [[With]] some six hundred years of architecture nearly untouched by natural disaster or war, the city retains much of its medieval appearance.

quiz.stem: As a special ______ for finishing the exams, Dad took us to an amusement park and let us stay until the fireworks ended.
quiz.explain_zh: treat＝難得的樂事。考完試後爸爸帶我們去遊樂園作為特別的犒賞。

quiz.stem: Unlike her classmates, who dream of studying abroad, Mia is perfectly ______ to stay in her hometown and help run the family farm.
quiz.explain_zh: content＝滿足的、甘願的。米亞甘願留在家鄉幫忙經營家裡的農場。

quiz.stem: According to the coach, the secret of the team's success ______ not in any single star player but in the trust among all its members.
quiz.explain_zh: lie＝在於。教練認為球隊成功的祕訣在於全體隊員的互信，而非單一明星球員。

quiz.stem: After months of investigation, police finally arrested the leaders of a ______ that had been selling fake concert tickets online.
quiz.explain_zh: ring＝（不法）集團。警方逮捕了在網路上販售假演唱會門票的集團首腦。

quiz.stem: After a two-week cold ______ damaged most of the tea leaves, farmers in the mountains asked the government for financial help.
quiz.explain_zh: spell＝一段時間。持續兩週的寒冷天氣凍壞茶葉，茶農請求補助。

quiz.stem: Many people claim that this herbal tea can cure a cold, yet scientists say there is no ______ evidence that it actually works.
quiz.explain_zh: hard＝確鑿的、可靠的。科學家表示沒有確鑿證據顯示花草茶能治感冒。

quiz.stem: With its low prices and fast delivery, the online bookstore has quickly become a major ______ in the country's book market.
quiz.explain_zh: player＝要角。這家網路書店已成為該國圖書市場的要角。

quiz.stem: Even after failing the audition twice, Lily kept her ______ outlook and told her friends that she would surely succeed the third time.
quiz.explain_zh: sunny＝開朗的、樂觀的。莉莉兩度落選仍保持樂觀，相信第三次會成功。

quiz.stem: Residents complained that smoke from the chemical ______ near the river was polluting the air and making their children cough.
quiz.explain_zh: plant＝工廠。居民抱怨河邊化工廠排出的煙汙染空氣。

quiz.stem: After winning the national championship for the fourth ______ year, the school's debate team was invited to compete overseas.
quiz.explain_zh: straight＝連續的。辯論隊連續第四年奪得全國冠軍。
